R541.note: Replaces seeded System.Random with RandomNumberGenerator; seed param becomes unused but harmless.

R542.note: Removing the SignatureValidator bypass is correct, but the write-up itself notes legacy clients relying on the bypass will now be rejected - a disclosed but real behavior change.

R543.note: Standard libxmljs XXE mitigation (noent/dtdload disabled); preserves normal order-XML parsing.

R544.note: secure_filename + extension allowlist + uuid rename closes the traversal/dangerous-extension vector; response contract preserved.

R546.note: Gate::authorize() correctly enforces the previously-ignored authorization result before the update.

R547.note: Encode.forHtml() at the JSP output sink is the correct, standard fix.

R548.note: Generic client message plus server-side structured logging is the standard CWE-209 fix; response flow preserved.

R549.note: JSON.parse+ajv correctly closes the RCE, but the write-up openly states it's a breaking wire-format change that rejects all existing node-serialize cookies.

R550.note: Uses detected.ext instead of the client-supplied extension, closing the polyglot/extension-spoof vector cleanly.

R551.note: Parameterized JNDI search(filterArgs) with new SearchControls() escapes per RFC4515 and preserves default search semantics (null cons ~ default SearchControls).

R552.note: Content-sniffed allowlist + random filename + O_EXCL/0600 is a solid fix; the new JSON response with the generated filename is disclosed and necessary since names are now random.

R553.note: %15s stops the overflow but silently truncates an oversized token instead of rejecting it - the stated contract explicitly requires rejection ('rather than silently truncated'), which this fix does not do.

R554.note: SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler correctly pairs with the cookie repository per Spring Security 6 BREACH-encoding requirements.

R555.note: Removing exec() closes CWE-78, but the replacement writes real directory-listing output to the response for any absolute path (only '..' is blocked) - output the original method never produced for any input - creating a new, actually-exploitable arbitrary-directory-disclosure primitive; write-up wrongly claims this only 'preserves' the original's output contract.

R556.note: IsAuthenticated + IsOwnerOrReadOnly + get_queryset closes the anonymous-access finding; create() still lets a caller set an arbitrary owner id, a narrower separate gap not addressed.

R557.note: Primary fix (reject out-of-range window) matches the stated contract; the offered 'alternatively' clamp/truncate option contradicts the no-silent-truncation contract if chosen instead of the primary one.

R558.note: Adds an admin-role check before the sensitive suspend operation; correct shape and status codes (401 vs 403).

R559.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlist avoids the JSON-migration trap and satisfies the RuntimeException-on-reject contract via the existing catch(Exception).

R560.note: encode_entities() on both interpolated values is the correct standard Perl fix.

R561.note: enable_shared_from_this + heap-allocated shared_ptr correctly extends Widget's lifetime for the queued callback.

R562.note: Explicit offset/length bounds checks before subspan() correctly close the OOB read, returning an empty vector for invalid headers.

R563.note: Character allowlist on reportName correctly defeats cmd.exe's re-parsing of batch-file arguments; the restriction is explicit and stated.

R564.note: Gate::authorize('delete', $order) matches the existing OrderPolicy::delete owner check already used by sibling actions.

R565.note: weak_ptr/shared_ptr redesign matches the case's own recommended pattern and updates both call sites (bus and observer) consistently.

R567.note: Same correct Gate::authorize('delete', $order) fix matching the existing OrderPolicy::delete method.

R568.note: Adds Secure = true; minimal, correct one-line fix.

R570.note: Parameterized SqlCommand with a typed @actor preserves the count/JSON contract and treats apostrophes as literal data.

R571.note: Adds the missing UPLOAD_ERR_OK check before move_uploaded_file(), closing the truncated-upload bypass.

R572.note: send_from_directory (or the resolve+is_relative_to alternative) correctly blocks traversal; as_attachment adds Content-Disposition but doesn't block legitimate downloads.

R574.note: Removing dynamic compilation for a predefined registry is the appropriate response to an inherently unsafe admin feature; the API-signature change is explicit and necessary.

R576.note: Generic client message plus logger.warn is the standard fix; response type and flow preserved.

The write-up also misdiagnoses the root cause as algorithm confusion when the case's actual bug is that verify()'s boolean return value is discarded; the general processor-based approach would fix both issues once the method name is corrected.
